title: Rebuild the Edge Scrum workspace and development workflows
acceptance: A fresh Edge session can query PI-01 sprint 1, create and revise a draft, append a note, link it to a work item, run 0.1 server and browser QA, and publish a PDF using the documented commands.
evidence: PR #3 on `edge-opencode/wi-008-scrum-workspace`, base `codex/development-workspace`: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/3. Adds grouped `scrumWorkspace` storage, `manual`, `validate`, `receipt`, a 12-test suite and the GitHub development lifecycle skill with CI and agent attribution. Verified: `npm test` 12/12, MCP initialize/tools/list/tools/call, `qa 0.1`, `browser 0.1`, `publish --changed`, `validate` ok with 24 records. Limits: no FoundationOS UI; planning, control and access deferred; owner acceptance pending.
